| ShipHull | id=nord_medium_ship; name=Drakkar; description={=vfcFN9bK}The Nords claim that the god Fryr taught their people the secret of the lapstrake, a technique of shipbuilding in which planks overlap each other to create a strong, light hull. | ShipHull | id=khuzait_heavy_ship; name=Qalguk; description={=9l40SnwD}The qalguk is a product of a very different shipbuilding tradition than other heavy warships, that of the cities on the eastern edge of Lake Tanaesis. Until recently, both sides of the lake were part of the Empire, and there was little need for ships that could stand in a battle-line. The coming of the Khuzaits from the eastern steppe however brought war to Tanaesis, and the khans demanded fleets that were the equal of any other realm from his new subjects. What they received was the qalguk, a warship made by shipwrights who learned their trade building merchantmen and pleasure-craft for the great lake. Compared to other heavies it is delicate, and finicky, but it can outrun virtually any other vessel on the water. Despite the limitations, the khans appreciated a ship that gave them the same advantage at sea as their horses did on land: the choice to avoid hand-to-handing fighting and pepper the enemy with arrows, or, if they thought they had an advantage, to close quickly and strike a devastating blow.; mission_ship=ship_xebec; skeletal_crew_capacity=32; main_deck_crew_capacity=66; total_crew_capacity=100; max_hitpoints=32000; max_fire_hitpoints=32000; max_sail_hitpoints=16000; ship_type=heavy; has_hold=true; base_speed=2.8; default_group=Cavalry; can_navigate_shallow_water=false; can_equip_figurehead=true; production_build_weight=2.0; value=62000; sea_worthiness=34; inventory_capacity=4000; map_visual_scale=0.055 |

| ShipHull | id=aserai_heavy_ship; name=Ghurab; description={=rQgQkgZ7}The ghurab, or ?crow?, is the Aserai sultanate?s answer to the dromon. | ShipHull | id=central_light_ship; name=Eastern Galley; description={=WWJcXPqY}This galley is common in southern and eastern Calradia, in the more restricted waters of the Gulf of Charas, the Perassic Sea and Lake Tanaesis. | ShipHull | id=empire_heavy_ship; name=Dromon; description={=wQ7ahU73}The dromon is the work of imperial shipwrights who have taken the heavy galleys of the early empire and updated them with the technologies of the seafaring peoples of the south and east. | ShipHull | id=crusas_roundship_nested_q5; name=Roundship; description={=mfo5vaD9}When Vlandians arrived on the shores of Calradia they sailed in simple craft similar to Nord longships. But, just as the first generations of Vlandian settlers learned to build fortifications to protect their new lands, so they also learned to build citadels upon the waves, the great roundships, to protect the commerce that enriched them. Their basic lines are similar to those of cogs common in Vlandian ports but the roundship is nearly twice as large, mounting two large square sails. {=1ieLd5qq}The townsfolk told you that the spy has no distinctive scars or other facial markings.
{=2VRTPyZY}{SETTLEMENT} is yours.
{=3FvGk8k6}Your settlement {SETTLEMENT} is besieged by {PARTY} of {FACTION}!
{=5bIpeW9X}Your alley in {SETTLEMENT} is under attack from neighboring gangs. Unless you go to their help, the alley will be lost in {RESPONSE_TIME} days.
{=5uXs8pS9}Complete All Building Projects in {SETTLEMENT_NAME}
{=8Wy1OCsr}The {WEAPON} of {BESIEGER} hit wall of {SETTLEMENT}!
{=9y0zpKUF}You need to be the owner of this settlement!
{=A2oos2Uo}Listen to me. I'm on assignment from {QUEST_GIVER.NAME}. Have any strangers been around here, asking odd questions about the garrison?
{=aN85Kfnq}{SETTLEMENT} was raided. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is canceled.
{=b3MBZKuQ}We came here looking for work, as there was none in the village. But the masters want skilled hands only. With a few coins, I could go home.
{=bRMLn0jj}Well, if he wanders off to another town, or gets his throat slit,[if:convo_pondering] or loses the deed, that would be the wrong moment, now wouldn't it?
{=btynhBAn}The new governor of {SETTLEMENT}, {HERO.NAME}, has arrived and taken up the reins of office.
{=bUweVtkk}Why doesn't {OWNER.LINK} do anything about the thieves plying their trade out on the street? Could it be that {?OWNER.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} is getting a cut of their take?
{=CdRtnwwX}Things are good, and {NOTABLE.LINK} says we should credit this to the wisdom of {?OWNER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} {OWNER.LINK}.
{=Ckou6bfg}Old skinflint {NOTABLE.FIRSTNAME} is my great-uncle's son, and not a blessed penny will {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} give me in hard times.
{=cKz1cyuM}Your clan is now at war with {QUEST_GIVER_SETTLEMENT_FACTION}. Quest is canceled.
{=cpTMttNb}Is that so? Hey, caravan captain, whatever your name is
{=CqnAGehj}suppose someone wanted to buy some goods and didn't want to pay the customs tax. We might be able to help that person out.
{=DgxVa0OP}The {?NOTABLE.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} {NOTABLE.LINK}...
{=DRpcqEMI}The caravan leader said your decisions were wasting their time and decided to go on his way. You have failed to uphold your part in the plan.
{=F44s8kPB}Where is the caravan? My men can't wait here for too long.[if:convo_undecided_open]
{=FnkYfyGa}the {WEAPON} of {BESIEGER} hit ranged engines of {SETTLEMENT}!
{=FvtAJE2Q}In order to find {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}'s daughter, you have decided to visit nearby villages.
{=HF2GIpbI}Listen to me. Have any of the tournament participants spent long hours in the market and tavern? More than usual?
{=i96KTeph}I can sell you information about {OWNER_CLAN}, who are the owners of our town {SETTLEMENT} for {PRICE}{GOLD_ICON}.
{=JgrG0uoO}Having the {TARGET_MERCHANT.LINK} by your side, you were successful in protecting the caravan.
{=K1ICRis9}I have heard you are looking for extra swords to protect your caravan. I am here to offer my services.
{=KbMew14D}Although the gang leader and the caravaneer joined their forces, you have successfully defeated them and kept the loot for yourself.
{=lZjj3MZg}When {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} arrived, you kept your side of the bargain and attacked the caravan
{=mfVJBFUD}The tax on this, the tax on that... Now just what do we think our beloved {?OWNER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\?} {OWNER.LINK} does with it all?
{=N1ZiaLRL}You talked to {TARGET_MERCHANT.LINK} as {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} asked. The caravan is waiting for you outside the gates to be escorted to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}.
{=NGcKLV88}A good engineer could help construct siege engines and new buildings in towns.
{=NOb4GcOT}{NOTABLE.LINK} says we must trust in the wisdom of the authorities, so long as they follow the laws of the Heavens.
{=OiCCfAeC}{SETTLEMENT} is taken. Election is started.
{=oulvvl52}You are accused in {SETTLEMENT} of a crime, and {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} no longer trusts you in this matter.
{=P7aRBg2h}Thank the heavens we have {?NOTABLE.GENDER}women{?}men{\?} like {NOTABLE.LINK} to help the poor in these hard times.
{=PUtbpIFI}Gather all my companions in the settlement and find me.
{=QyGQanO7}There's no doubt that {NOTABLE.FIRSTNAME} is a stiff-necked old goat, but you can't say {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?}'s not honest as the day is long.
{=RAA6bEw8}If you're a stranger in this town, I'm sure you can find someone who'll let you stay on a pile of straw or under a bridge for a few coppers.
{=rTrGXB1o}Yeah.. Word is that {._}{ITEM_NAME} sells well in {TOWN_NAME}. A profit of {PRICE_DIFF}{GOLD_ICON} a load, they say.
{=SHwlcdp3}I ask you because you are a trader here. Have you seen one of the warriors in the tournament walking around here, asking people a lot of suspicious questions?
{=TMhUM4tz}Heard that {NOTABLE.LINK} is making money hand over fist from {?NOTABLE.GENDER}her{?}his{\?} {.%}{SHOP_TYPE}{.%}. A cunning one, {?NOTABLE.GENDER}she{?}he{\?} is.
{=uJNvbag5}The walls of {SETTLEMENT} has been cracked.
{=vAjgn7yx}Rival Gang Moving in at {SETTLEMENT}
{=vGnY4KBO}I care very little for your threats. My business is with {TARGET_NOTABLE.LINK}.
{=vpUl7xcy}You have defeated the rival gang and protected the interests of {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} in {SETTLEMENT}.
{=W7TD4yTc}You know, {TARGET_MERCHANT.NAME}'s man makes a good point. I'm guarding this caravan.
{=wAgfOHio}You have lost the ownership of the alley at {SETTLEMENT}.
{=WqY4nvHc}{TARGET_NOTABLE.LINK}'s village {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} was raided. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is canceled.
{=XN0XZAkI}I can't let you in. My {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME} would be furious.
{=YTaM6G1E}It seems the village has been raided a short while ago. You found nothing but smoke, fire and crying people.
{=ZhCRL9mY}All those bastards walking around drunk and bothering folks.. But they work for {NOTABLE.LINK} and you can't say a thing if you value your head.
{=ZrMeSyPu}The {WEAPON} of {BESIEGER} hit some soldiers in {SETTLEMENT}!
{=ZVbQemrz}My husband was wounded in the wars, and now can't pull a plow. So he lost his tenancy, and now I must beg in the marketplace.

## Implementation Judgement From File Audit

- NavalDLC is a full campaign-layer expansion in this install, not just items/scenes. It changes active settlements and adds Nord kingdom data. Bannerwake should depend on it and extend it deliberately.
- The local files already contain maritime surfaces for fleets, ship ownership, ports, shipyards, storms, blockades, fire damage, boarding, patrols, fishing parties, merchant parties, and pirate spawn zones. Black Keel, Renegati, Lake Rats, Vlandian landings, and Nord politics should all use these where possible.
- Settlement coordinates from base SandBox are wrong when NavalDLC is active. Use NavalDLC settlement coordinates for any spatial logic.
- Faction XML requires home settlement anchoring. Treat Diathma drift as missing/invalid faction home data or failed runtime repair, not as an unavoidable mystery.
- Custom cultures are expensive. They require troop, militia, rebel, civilian, guard, notable, body, equipment, name, party-template, and naval-role completeness. Use custom cultures only for Black Keel-style settlement production or similarly deep needs.
- Vrak and Black Keel should not be implemented as normal single minor factions if they own settlements and have multiple leaders/clans. Their design implies pseudo-kingdom or custom kingdom state.
- The binary string audit is sufficient to identify likely names, but final code needs exact signatures from ILSpy/dnSpy against v1.4.5.114824 assemblies.
